content:
It's time to check out the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple's newest products officially opened for pre-order this morning, and major brands are ready to go. Apple has launched a colourful range of silicone cases, brand-new TechWoven fabric cases, and a host of classic designs from leading third-party makers. From a brand-new burgundy version with a built-in stand, to ultra-personalised models with a superb feel, to premium leather offerings from the likes of Nomad and Burton Goods – there's something for everyone. Brands such as Spigen also offer budget-friendly options starting from $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro cases

Updating…

Apple

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe (Sky Blue): $59

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Silicone Case with MagSafe (Burgundy): $49

Featured pick: ESR

ESR's brand-new range of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories has officially arrived, with premium colour options and patented technology. The standout is the new Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe case, which features a built-in zinc-alloy Flex stand that seamlessly integrates with the camera bump for added protection, and is said to deliver 3x military-grade protection while being "soft, bouncy and comfortable to the touch". The new Atelier range comes in four colourways, with additional accessories available to perfectly match the new burgundy, glacier, black and silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand: $42 (originally $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector: $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case: $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Card Wallet Stand with Non-Slip Grip: $46 (originally $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad, the renowned premium leather case brand, has its full range of cases ready for all iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max flagship models. The brand has also launched its brand-new Rugged Case line this year, with each colourway featuring contour textures inspired by the Baja California peninsula:

  • Rugged Case: $70
  • Colours: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather Case: $69
  • Colours: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back: $59
  • Colours: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case: $55
  • Colours: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case: $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case: $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case: $79
  • Colours: Rustic Brown

Featured pick: Dbrand

Dbrand's hugely popular Grip Case is ready for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Aside from sporting one of the cleanest designs around and an ultra-grippy texture, it continues to offer full support for customisable skins this year, letting you add a personal touch; pair it with a matching Prism screen protector and you'll get a discount as well.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $55. Customisable, drop-proof, ultra-grippy, with excellent button feel.
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max), 2-pack: $35 (save $5 when purchased with a case). Easy install, auto-alignment, completely dust-free.

Dbrand has also launched its brand-new MNML case line this year, starting from $39, focusing on minimalist yet stylish design at an affordable price, retaining MagSafe support while keeping the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case: $39. Colours: Black, Marine, Tan, Burgundy.

Spigen

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro, Black): $14 (originally $18)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro, Clear): $13 (originally $17)
  • Spigen Nano Pop MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro, Black): $20 (originally $22)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Black): $14 (originally $18)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Clear): $13 (originally $17)
  • Spigen Nano Pop MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Burgundy): $21 (originally $24)
  • Spigen Slim Armor MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro, Black): $26 (originally $50)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro, Blue): $19 (originally $40)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Black): $19 (originally $40)

Arc

Arc's 2026 Pulse aerospace-grade metal bumper cases have arrived, with several new colourways added this year to complement Apple's Glacier and Burgundy phones:

  • Matte Black — $69.99
  • Polished Silver — $89.99
  • Polished Graphite — $99.99
  • Matte Sky Blue — $119.99
  • Matte Deep Red — $119.99
  • Polished Gold — $129.99
  • Titanium Black — $299.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • Full Leather Case (iPhone 18 series): $59
  • Colours: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • Modular Case (iPhone 18 series): $59
  • A detachable magnetic back panel lets you switch between two modes. With the back panel attached: a full-grain leather case with a slim design and MagSafe support.

Burton Goods

***Note: Enter our exclusive code 9TO520 at checkout for an extra 20% off the already reduced launch price (valid on the cases below). If the code doesn't work, try DUO10.

  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $60 (originally $80)
  • Luxury Pocket Book Folio (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $89 (originally $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo): $60 (originally $80)

UAG

UAG has also released a range of cases for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including its signature reinforced corners, anti-slip edges, and rugged models with various drop-protection designs. If you're after a case that can withstand harsh conditions while remaining suitable for everyday protection, the UAG range is well worth considering.

  • UAG Mouve (iPhone Duo): $65
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case (iPhone 18 Pro & 18 Pro Max): $80
  • UAG Civilian Grip Case: from $60
  • More…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max cases

If you want a rugged case for your new phone but aren't keen on the usual suspects like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut range is well worth considering. These cases have passed MIL-STD-810H drop tests, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're after a premium iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max case that doesn't make your phone too bulky, Mous is a strong contender. Mous is now offering ultra-thin aramid fibre cases for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, as well as the following models.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case: $75
  • Mous Clear Case: $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case: $85
  • Mous Slim MagSafe Case: $55
  • Mous Slim Aramid Fibre Case: $70
  • More…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are renowned for their futuristic design, cutting-edge style and slim profile, standing out with unique textured finishes.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fibre Case: $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case (iPhone 18 Pro): $60
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case: $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are ideal for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users seeking an ultra-slim design. Their products are typically crafted from lightweight aramid fibre, offering a clean, understated look while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and providing extra protection around the camera and frame.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Texture Case: $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop-Resistant Aramid Case: $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case: $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro series cases

OtterBox also offers a diverse range of case options for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, from slim everyday models to heavy-duty rugged designs with reliable protection. Several new models support MagSafe, with some featuring more grippy sides, accessory slots, raised camera protection and built-in stands, allowing you to choose based on your preferred thickness and protection level.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro: $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series: $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand: $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series: $60
  • More…

Belkin

Belkin is another reliable option for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, particularly suited to users who prefer a clean style, don't want their phone to become too bulky, yet don't need a full military-grade case. Their range typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised screen and camera edges, while certain models (such as Protect+) add reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and a slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case: $30
  • Belkin Qi2-compatible MagSafe Case with Anti-Slip Grip: $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners: $60
